subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park legacy outbox rows whose agent owner cannot be proven, while migrating cached sessions and transcripts to agent-scoped ownership?
rationale: This prevents cross-chat replay but changes persisted recovery behavior for existing installations, and repository policy treats schema-version and upgrade compatibility choices as explicit maintainer decisions.

options.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
options.body: Accept manual recovery for ambiguous legacy rows and land after exact-head Android validation completes.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Preserve legacy rows without automatic replay unless ownership can be proven, pending a separate recovery design.

options.title: Split transient and durable fixes
options.body: Land transient composer isolation separately and pause the Room cache and outbox migration.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Accept manual recovery for ambiguous legacy rows and land after exact-head Android validation completes.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the broad persistence and owner-binding expansion and is best positioned to confirm that its upgrade behavior is intentional.
